scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" -n "MONGO,SRV,FRONT" "docker compose up -d" "cd backend && bun run dev" "cd frontend && bun run dev"
scripts.dev:quick: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" -n "SRV,FRONT" "cd backend && bun run dev" "cd frontend && bun run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js
scripts.lint: cd backend && bun run lint && cd frontend && bun run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && bun run typecheck && cd frontend && bun run typecheck
